title: Queries in Liquid, Razor and the API | Orchard Core
description:
A saved query in Orchard Core has a name, and templates, views and other applications need a way to run it and read its results.

Liquid templates run a query with the Queries property and the query filter, Razor views call ContentQueryAsync or QueryAsync on the Orchard helper, and the web API returns the result as JSON at api/queries/{name}. All three pass parameters to the query, and the API checks a permission.

In this video:
• The RecentBlogPosts query and its limit parameter
• The Queries property and the query filter in Liquid
• ContentQueryAsync and QueryAsync in Razor
• The api/queries endpoint, its permissions and its sign-in
• Choosing between the three
